questions.prompt: What were Luca and Fern moving?

stimulus.title: The borrowed cart
stimulus.body: Luca and Fern had to move books from the office to the school library. The caretaker lent them a garden cart. Luca made one tall pile, but a few books slid onto the grass when the cart turned. Fern suggested three lower piles instead. Ahead, a step blocked the cart's small wheels. They could unload everything and lift the cart, or take the longer path around the back of the building. They chose the smooth back path. The other helpers arrived first, but Luca and Fern delivered every book clean and dry. Luca decided to check the path before loading next time.

questions.explanation: The first sentence identifies the books they had to move.
